headline: Gold steady near ₹14,345 per gram; silver flat around ₹2,04,900 per kg
summary: Gold's 24k rate moved just ₹1 (about 0.01%) from yesterday, so today's change is negligible. Over the last 7 days (since 31 October) gold is up about 3.29%, and over the full 13-day history it is up about 0.49%, after touching ₹14,602 on 5 November within that window. Silver fell ₹100 per kg today (about 0.05%), is up about 2.45% over 7 days, but is down about 6.86% since 26 October, when it stood at ₹2,20,000 per kg. Likely drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements and festive or wedding demand, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: With prices barely changed today, there is no urgency either way; if you are buying jewellery, compare making charges and GST, which are not included in these rates.
